text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She couldn't claim victory...
Yet, despite being told it was "still too soon,"
Tamamo Cross ran the Kikuka Sho all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeze*... I knew it was reckless.
I knew, and yet... I conquered Kyoto's 3000 meters!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I've etched it in... With my own eyes, with my own legs.
The slopes, the curves, the straights, and just how exhausting that final stretch is."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah... With this...!
With this, next year is ours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was too exhilarated for it to be a mere whim.
It was obvious she carried some hidden motive
for entering the race.
choice_data_list: Tamamo, what are you aiming for?
Tamamo, what are you aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's just personal stuff.
Due to some minor circumstances, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pop quiz time! When it comes to long-distance GⅠs
at Kyoto, there's the Kikuka Sho, and...
what's the other one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, I think about it.
The prime example that comes to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There are folks who worship that race,
the "Tenno Sho (Spring)," as the greatest race of all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's—me dad!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, they're traditional craftsmen through and through.
Their passion for historic races is seriously no joke."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show 'em. In my absolute favorite race,
runnin' my heart out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even if it's a bit reckless,
this time I gotta.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exhausted, Tamamo Cross grinned.
It seemed this race was also a bit of practice for her family's sake.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
It's over now, isn't it... the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City. Good work today.
Thanks to you, it's been a great year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Before the Triple Crown, hearin' you talk about food
kinda changed the way I look at things, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Bein' able to stand here is all thanks to ya, City.
Much obliged."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was the one...
who gained courage from that toughness.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even when we weren't running together, I felt like we were running in the same race.
The entire time..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, I suppose that's just how classmates are.
There are things only we can share with each other.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know heaps of other folks, but...
I'm real glad you're here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished running the Classic Road,
the two now embark from here. Into the uncharted territory
of races mixed with Classic and Senior divisions.
